title: 2023 Panini Donruss #D-36 Aaron Donald Los Angeles Rams Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This trading card features Aaron Donald, a dominant player for the Los Angeles Rams in the National Football League (NFL). The card is from the 2023 Panini Donruss set, which includes various features and inserts. The card number is D-36 and it is a sports trading card of the type mentioned before. It is not autographed and is part of the Dominators insert set. The season is 2023 and the card is manufactured by Panini.
